description: webgis.adbpo.it: wastewater datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by webgis.adbpo.it. Coverage: the area served by webgis.adbpo.it. The listing groups 4 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about wastewater; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Scarichi industriali IPPC (Integrated Pollution Prevention and Control; Impianti depurazione acque reflue urbane Bacino Po 2015 (Distretto Po); Agglomerati urbani e impianti depurazione acque reflue urbane Bacino P; Scarichi industriali non IPPC (Integrated Pollution Prevention and Con. Formats seen: WFS, WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
